test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

Some doors are locks.

No lock is a key.

Conclusions:

(I) No door is a key.

(II) Some locks are doors.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26e78b0a2b0e9f46414c5f0f25e886d81260661533c377f030ff491039c1af8d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ded7dfe4c3c4f3896f5413332eb0047e6f90087692c605a8e2fd02a6f23c16e2.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No door is a key → Does not follow (As some doors are locks and no lock is a key. As no direct relation is given between doors and key, therefore it is false)

(II) Some locks are doors → Follow (As some doors are locks. As some part of doors is common with locks, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
